mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log (biz_type, biz_id, order_id, action, action_text, detail, operator_id, operator_name, operator_role) VALUES (#{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{orderId}, #{action}, #{actionText}, #{detail}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{operatorRole})
mapper.select: SELECT id, biz_type, biz_id, order_id, action, action_text, detail, operator_id, operator_name, operator_role, created_at FROM operation_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY created_at, id
